sections.body: The Rust API Guidelines are recommendations for the design, documentation, and testing of Rust APIs. They help an API author write an API that is easy to use and hard to misuse. Each guideline carries a stable code (for example C-CONV) and is enforced in practice by Clippy lints.

The Rust Style Guide captures the common style conventions of the Rust community: naming, whitespace, comments, error handling, and more. It is a style reference, not a compiler or linter, and is updated on the nightly documentation.

The Cargo Book documents the Rust build system and package manager. `cargo build` compiles the current package (and its dependencies) for the target platform, writing artifacts under `target/`. Run `cargo <command> --help` for the full option list; the book explains each command, its flags, and their effects.
qualifications: Run `cargo build --help` for the authoritative, version-specific option list.

sections.body: The Rustc Book is a reference for the `rustc` compiler: how to invoke it, its command-line options, and how to read its diagnostics. Because the reference tracks the nightly toolchain, a stable `rustc` may differ from the documented flags.
qualifications: The rustc reference tracks the nightly toolchain; flag behaviour can differ on stable.

sections.body: The Rustup Book documents the Rust toolchain installer: installing, updating, and managing toolchains and components. `rustup show` reports the installed and active toolchains; `rustup update` brings a toolchain current.

The rustfmt Book documents `rustfmt`, the code formatter that ships as a component of the Rust distribution. It lists the options `rustfmt` accepts and how to configure it via a `rustfmt.toml` file. Because rustfmt is a nightly component, its option set can change.
qualifications: rustfmt is a nightly component; its option set can change between releases.

sections.body: The Clippy configuration reference documents the lint groups, individual lint levels, and per-lint options. Clippy is a nightly component, so a specific lint may be added, renamed, or removed between releases; treat an unfamiliar lint as possibly version-dependent.
qualifications: Clippy is a nightly component; a lint may be added or removed between releases.

sections.body: The Rustdoc Book documents `rustdoc`, the documentation generator for Rust. It lists the command-line options that control the generated documentation, from output formats to the HTML template and theme. Because rustdoc tracks the compiler, option behaviour can differ between toolchains.
qualifications: rustdoc tracks the compiler; option behaviour can differ between toolchains.
